ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The right side of the figure shows an ester group fragment, with R-O- connected to the carbonyl carbon C(=O). The left side of the carbonyl carbon is connected to a carbon, and that carbon has R2 attached downward. This carbon is further connected to another carbon on the left; the left carbon has R1, OH attached, and is also connected to a hydroxylamine-like group containing N-O-H. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question asks to ignore the arrows. Reasoning: Represent all three R substituents with the wildcard atom "*". Starting from the ester-end R wildcard, traverse as *-O-C(=O)-, then to the adjacent carbon bearing R2, written as C(*), then to the left carbon bearing R1, OH, and N-O, written as C(*)(O)NO. Removing the schematic connection hyphens gives the SMILES as *OC(=O)C(*)C(*)(O)NO.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image connectivity, ignoring all arrows: the right side is an ester R-O-C(=O)-; the carbonyl carbon is bonded to an adjacent carbon bearing R2; that carbon is bonded to another carbon bearing R1, OH, and an NHOH group. Convert the three R substituents to wildcard atoms '*'. Traverse from the ester R wildcard through the ester oxygen and carbonyl, then through the two carbon centers: *O-C(=O)-C(*)-C(*)(O)-N-O. Remove bond dashes and write the valid SMILES as *OC(=O)C(*)C(*)(O)NO.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中右侧显示一个酯基片段，R-O-连接到羰基碳C(=O)。羰基碳左侧连接到一个碳，该碳向下连有R2。这个碳再连接到左侧的另一个碳；左侧碳连有R1、OH，并且还连到一个含N-O-H的羟胺样基团。图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：把三个R取代基都用通配符原子“*”表示。从酯端R通配符开始遍历为 *-O-C(=O)-，再到相邻的带R2的碳写作 C(*)，再到左侧带R1、OH和N-O的碳写作 C(*)(O)NO。去掉示意连接短横线，得到SMILES为 *OC(=O)C(*)C(*)(O)NO。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecular skeleton in the image: an ester fragment R-O-C(=O)-, the carbonyl-adjacent carbon bearing R2, the next carbon bearing R1, OH, and an NHOH substituent; ignore the curved reaction arrows. planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is a SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and that arrows in the image should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons, heteroatoms are written explicitly, hydrogens on N/O are implicit as allowed, carbonyl is C(=O), ester oxygen connected to an R group can be written as *O, and unspecified R groups map to wildcard atoms '*'. Choose any valid traversal of the same graph, e.g. from the ester R group through O to the carbonyl and then along the carbon chain.
